mobile.name: frost giant
mobile.long_descr: A large form towers over you and swings his mighty club.
mobile.description:
The frost giant has no respect for any life, and does not care
what happens to him.  He is a fierce warrior, and unfortuneatly
not anyone's ally.

mobile.name: small squid
mobile.long_descr: A small squid hops out of the water at you.
mobile.description: The squid squirts its black stuff and you cannot even see it.

mobile.name: giant scorpian
mobile.long_descr: A giant scorpian is here scrounging for food.
mobile.description:
The scorpian has a sharp sting and deadly venom.  It would be a bad
thing to get too close.  It has a hard shell that looks nearly
impossible to crack into.

mobile.name: stone giant
mobile.long_descr: A large form towers over you and wields a heavy rock.
mobile.description:
The stone giant has no respect for any life, and does not care
what happens to him.  He is a fierce warrior, and unfortuneatly
not anyone's ally.

mobile.name: shadow
mobile.long_descr: A force of mighty elements is upon you, and it sure is MAD!
mobile.description:
The shadow does not like to be intruded upon, and it does not
take kindly to anyone.  With a huge magical burst, hundreds
of creatures are notified to your existance, and in moments
they will be upon you.

mobile.name: force of darkness
mobile.long_descr: The origin and force of darkness itself is here.
mobile.description:
You cannot actually see it, but it strikes every ounce of fear
in your body and hurts you deep within.  You feel its presence
and can detect its location, but that does not help you much.
